Halt.title: Halt
Halt.description:
Minutes since local midnight of the Fahrplan's day (beyond 1440 past midnight), None where
the time is missing. `ist` is the change time, else the planned time; None when cancelled.

Klasse.title: Klasse
Klasse.description:
How far a day is from its normal (a station's, a state's or Germany's), in the usual
variation of its reference days: 1 (much better), 2, 3 (as usual), 4, 5 (much worse).
None without a shown value or a normal.

Land.title: Land
Land.description: A federal state, valued like Germany from the large stations that feed Germany's value.

Normal.title: Normal
Normal.description: The median of a metric over the reference days; None with fewer than 8 valid days.

verteilung.title: Verteilung
verteilung.description: Non-cancelled stops per delay bin in whole minutes, 7 values: < 1 (early included), [1, 3), [3, 6), [6, 10), [10, 20), [20, 30), >= 30. Empty when n is 0.

Trend.title: Trend
Trend.description: Centred 28-day rolling median of the daily values; None with fewer than 14 values.
